frame calendar system

  • CURIE: gmeow:frameCalendarSystem
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/frameCalendarSystem
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/temporal

The calendar system of a temporal frame, when one is used. Optional: some frames (e.g. Julian Date) carry only a scale.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:TemporalFrame -> gmeow:CalendarSystem; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:frameCalendarSystem from gmeow:TemporalFrame to gmeow:CalendarSystem when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:TemporalFrame, gmeow:CalendarSystem
